title: AHB and AXI progress-monitoring models
summary: Implemented timeout and outstanding-transaction models, generalized read/write monitoring and corrected an incomplete state assignment.

dates.note: Null boundaries preserve unknown project/rotation dates. Inspected author/committer milestones are identified in evidence; they are not employment, project-start, shipment or acceptance dates.

facts.text: Implemented a parameterized AHB hang monitor that counts consecutive low-ready cycles, clears on progress/reset and reports stalled-bus errors through the testbench safety path.
Developed ID-aware outstanding-transaction tracking with coarse timestamp aging for AXI read hangs, then generalized the monitor for both read and write request/completion handshakes.
Corrected an incomplete combinational idle-state assignment in the AXI hang detector to address unintended latch behavior.

The AHB introduction’s subject says 1,000 cycles, while its source selects 100,000 and a later Michael patch selects 400,000. The separate scoreboard delay changes from 1,000 to 5,000; none is a measured latency or performance gain.

A colleague later split the monitor into read/write variants and added read beat counting; Michael’s generic code survives in the renamed write-model source. Legacy top-level instances were removed in 2022. No all-corner-case, clean-lint, current-use or timing guarantee is inferred.
